scope: HV divider and pipe roller stand illustrative CC0 assets; exact live drafted housing recheck

observations.HV divider: Three clearly separated splayed feet support the hub. The ceramic column seats on the hub and carries six sheds. The copper top terminal is on the ceramic top.
observations.pipe roller stand: Three splayed legs join the hub and central post. The head carries two parallel rollers, each between visible end brackets. Shafts pass through the rollers and bored brackets.
observations.drafted housing: Four cored posts are visibly inside the open teal shell. No ribs are present.

externalReferenceCheck.conclusion: Real supplier models have calibrated electrical specifications. No such electrical or structural claims are assigned to this scene prop.
